_doc: Which citations the manifesto's own repair worklists condemn, and which they merely mention. Read by tools/citation_gate.py, which refuses to let a condemned one appear in a published Codex lesson. Classify by NAME + YEAR: the year is usually what makes a citation false, and the same author often has a real work too.
_why_this_file_is_hand_curated: The worklists name the offender and its replacement in the same sentence — 'phantom futurist Elaine Day (2015) ... Weak-signal analysis belongs to Ansoff/Hiltunen' — so no regex can tell which of the two is the problem. A machine-derived list would condemn the fix.

The ratchet in the gate covers the cost of curating by hand: every Author (YYYY) the worklists mention must appear below as flagged or cleared, or the gate fails. A newly condemned source cannot be silently missed, which is the failure mode of every hand-maintained list.
